title: A one-to-one relationship filters from the second table to the first
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Products", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), ProductCategory[Category] = "Clothing" ) )

source.quote: For one-to-one relationships, the cross filter direction is always from both tables
source.supports: one-to-one relationships always filter from both tables

source.quote: An SSR relationship always uses bidirectional filtering

derivation: Category Clothing is SKU CL-01, which is one Product row (T-shirt).
